evals.prompt: Probe a local MP4, trim 00:00:12–00:00:19 to a new output, and determine whether the cut is frame-exact.
evals.expected_output: Probe-first operation with post-trim verification and an accurate statement about keyframe-limited stream-copy cuts.
expectations: Preserves the input unless overwrite is authorized.
Does not promise frame-exact stream-copy trimming without evidence.

evals.prompt: Transcode an existing video to H.264/yuv420p with AAC and fast-start; report duration, dimensions, codecs and output path.
evals.expected_output: Bounded transcode followed by output and stream verification.
expectations: Uses documented ffmpeg operations or argument-list subprocess.
Separates operation status from host artifact validation.

evals.prompt: Generate AI video from a text prompt; there is no existing media file to process.
evals.expected_output: Route prompt-to-video to Video Generator rather than attempting post-processing.
expectations: Does not claim ffmpeg generates source footage.
